pr_title: GameEngine: complete ADR0127 Native 2D first release
pr_body: Adds the current-main v7 service-backed Native 2D Editor workspace foundation: stable SpriteRef scene creation, typed Sprite Atlas / Sprite Animation / Tile Set authoring, and gesture-backed sparse Tile Map editing. Persisted mutations remain in shared authoring services; Scene View projection/drop and shell registration are intentionally separate exact-head slices.
